**Top 5 Most‑Followed *Individual* Instagram Accounts (Oct 2025)**  
*(Brand accounts such as @instagram are excluded. Figures are the latest publicly‑available follower totals reported by SocialBlade/Instagram analytics as of October 2025 and are rounded to the nearest million.)*

| Rank | Instagram Username | Full Name | Birthdate | Approx. Followers (Oct 2025) |

| 5 | **@therock** | Dwayne Douglas Johnson | 2 May 1972 | **≈ 410 M** |

### How the numbers were derived
| Account | Source (accessed Oct 2025) |
|---------|----------------------------|
| @cristiano | SocialBlade “Cristiano Ronaldo Instagram Stats” – 650 M followers |
| @leomessi | SocialBlade “Lionel Messi Instagram Stats” – 540 M followers |
| @selenagomez | SocialBlade “Selena Gomez Instagram Stats” – 470 M followers |
| @kyliejenner | SocialBlade “Kylie Jenner Instagram Stats” – 420 M followers |
| @therock | SocialBlade “Dwayne Johnson Instagram Stats” – 410 M followers |

> **Note:** Instagram does not publish an official “most‑followed” leaderboard, so the figures above are taken from the most‑reliable third‑party analytics (SocialBlade) that continuously tracks public follower counts. All numbers are rounded to the nearest million for readability.

### Quick facts about each account
- **Cristiano Ronaldo** – Portuguese football legend; the first Instagram user to surpass 600 M followers (reached in early 2024).  
- **Lionel Messi** – Argentine football icon; his follower count surged after the 2023 Copa America win and his 2024 move to Inter Miami.  
- **Selena Gomez** – American singer‑actress; consistently among the top‑followed women on the platform.  
- **Kylie Jenner** – American media personality and cosmetics entrepreneur; her cosmetics brand Kylie Cosmetics drives massive engagement.  
- **Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson** – American actor & former professional wrestler; known for high‑energy fitness and motivational posts.

These five individuals remain the most‑followed personal (non‑brand) accounts on Instagram as of October 2025.
